title: 複習四
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved review migration module R004; pair with R003. Milestone L060; coverage L031-L060; allowed-character ceiling through L060 only. Review modules introduce no new characters and have no zhuyin or charAudio.

generationConstraints.stage4PartialOrderRule: Blank exactly 3-4 Han characters. Every option card must be exactly one Han character; no chunks, phrase cards, or full-sentence reordering.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: Concrete phone-readable square image for: 大人比你更高。 Show the recurring young boy classmate for `你` standing beside a generic adult caregiver, with the adult clearly taller than the child. Use the recurring `你` boy identity: short slightly tousled dark hair, sky-blue shirt, green shorts, blue shoes, small orange backpack when useful. The generic adult caregiver must be visually distinct from protagonist mother, protagonist father, teacher, and the L058 adult woman. No written text, labels, numbers, signs, zhuyin, logos, or speech bubbles.

Concrete phone-readable square image for: 山上人多，山下人少。 Show a mountain scene with many varied people on the upper mountain path and fewer varied people at the lower mountain area, so 多 and 少 are clear at phone size. Use varied passersby: mixed adult and child ages, genders, hairstyles, clothing, and body shapes. Do not clone the same adult woman or reuse protagonist mother/teacher faces. No written text, labels, numbers, signs, zhuyin, logos, or speech bubbles.

Concrete phone-readable square image for: 吃起來很好吃。 Show a generic preschool child tasting a small bite of food and looking pleased, with the food clearly visible and appetizing. The scene should communicate that the food tastes good, without using text or speech bubbles. Human role identity: generic preschool child, visually distinct from recurring protagonist girl, recurring `你` boy, and recurring `他` boy. No written text, labels, numbers, signs, zhuyin, logos, or speech bubbles.

Concrete phone-readable square image for: 女孩很可愛。 Show a sweet, friendly generic preschool girl in a simple child scene, such as smiling while holding a small toy or sitting politely. Human role identity: generic preschool girl, visually distinct from the recurring protagonist girl `我` and from any classmate girl continuity. Do not make her look like the protagonist girl. No written text, labels, numbers, signs, zhuyin, logos, or speech bubbles.

Concrete phone-readable square image for: 不要這樣吃。 Show a very young generic child, about three to four years old, directly grabbing rice or soft food from a bowl with their hand. A generic adult caregiver nearby gently guides or stops the child with a calm expression. The scene should show a toddler/preschooler still learning table manners, not an older child acting rude. Human role identity: very young generic child and generic adult caregiver; both must be visually distinct from recurring protagonist family, teacher, and the L058 adult woman. No written text, labels, numbers, signs, zhuyin, logos, or speech bubbles.
